# Duke's Seafood — Preview Bundle

Three-page click-through preview for the Duke's stakeholder review. All wiring is done.

## What's in the folder

**Source files (don't deploy these directly):**
- `Duke_s_Seafood_-_Home__standalone_.html` — original Design export of the home page
- `Duke_s_Seafood_-_Bellevue__standalone_.html` — original Design export of Bellevue
- `about.html` — the Our Story page we built together
- `build.py` — patches all three for inter-page navigation

**Generated by build.py (these are what get deployed):**
- `index.html` — patched home
- `bellevue.html` — patched Bellevue
- `about.html` — pass-through, already wired

**Config:**
- `vercel.json` — clean URLs, no trailing slash

## Deploy

```bash
cd dukes-preview
python3 build.py        # regenerates index.html and bellevue.html
vercel --prod
```

Vercel will assign a URL. Send Duke's three direct links:

- `https://[your-project].vercel.app/` — home
- `https://[your-project].vercel.app/bellevue` — location page
- `https://[your-project].vercel.app/about` — our story

## What's wired vs not

**Wired between preview pages:**
- Home wordmark/logo → home (self)
- Home location card "Bellevue" → bellevue.html
- Home "Read our history" CTA → about.html
- Bellevue self-link in sibling-location list → bellevue.html
- Bellevue's other location links (Lake Union, Green Lake, etc.) → index.html, so clicks stay in-preview
- About page logo → index.html
- About footer Bellevue → bellevue.html

**Left pointing at the live site (intentional):**
- Menus, blog, gift cards, frozen chowders, recipes, VIP signup, Saving Salmon foundation post

Clicking "Menus" or "Blog" from any preview page takes Duke's to the current live site. That's a feature, not a bug; it gives them an implicit before/after comparison during the review. Mention it in the email: "Top-nav links to menus/blog/gift cards go to the current site for now; the new design only covers home, Bellevue, and About."

## If you need to rebuild

The build is idempotent. Re-run `python3 build.py` whenever you change `about.html` or drop in a new Design export. It overwrites `index.html` and `bellevue.html` with fresh patches.

## Image hosting note

The about page hot-links images from six third-party hosts. They will load fine in browsers visiting your Vercel deploy. If any are broken, open `about.html`, find the broken image URL, save the file locally to an `images/` folder, and swap the URL.

The third-party-hosted photos (Forbes, Seattle Magazine, ParentMap) are fine for an internal mockup but should be replaced with Duke's-owned assets before any of this goes near production.
